leadText:
Only One Story is the Japanese opening theme for the Rayquaza Rising arc and the fourth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ068, replacing . The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on October 11, 2024. 

A Korean version of the song, titled Only One Story (Korean ver.), is the opening theme for the Korean dub of the Rayqyaza Rising arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ068, replacing . The full version of the song was released as a digital single on April 15, 2025.

A Korean version of the song, titled Only One Story (Korean ver.), is the opening theme for the Korean dub of the Rayqyaza Rising arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ068, replacing . The full version of the song was released as a digital single on April 15, 2025. 

==Opening animation==
===Synopsis===
Clouds are blowing fast in the sky when the Black Rayquaza appears and flies over them. Liko, Roy, Dot, , , , and Terapagos gaze at the sunny sky. Dot moves forward first, followed by Roy, and then Liko with Terapagos. They all run forward before stopping at the cliff, with Rayquaza flying in the distance. The series logo appears just as flies into it.

Dot's Room on the Brave Olivine is draped in purple, and Dot is at her desk as an overlay of her feeling frustrated appears. The swirling clouds in the sky are draped in red, and Roy is desperately reaching out for Rayquaza as an overlay of him feeling conflicted as he holds the Sky High Pokémon's ancient Poké Ball appears. The battlefield at Naranja Academy is draped in blue, and Liko recalls one of her fainted Pokémon back into its Poké Ball as an overlay of her feeling sad about her loss appears.

Liko's overlay becomes a transition into the next scene in a colorless background. Liko takes a step, causing green leaves to appear from under her foot. She then reaches out for the full moon with the camera zooming out from her blue eyes, which appear to be the only thing colored. Liko notices a green and sparkly shadow of running past her, followed by and . They all go in front of the Rising Volt Tacklers, becoming their second-stage Evolutions and turning everything colorful. Roy and Dot appear alongside Liko, and they all run towards the Rising Volt Tacklers together.

The screen turns completely white, shortly followed by a swinging transition of Liko's pendant. Carmine is in the Kitakami Hall, when causes her to drop her Syrupy Apple. Briar reads the Scarlet Book at the Crystal Pool, and the camera zooms in on her left earring, which turns into a transition. Perrin snaps a photo with Hisuian in a bamboo forest. A darker part of the forest is shown which 's back turned.

Sidian, Coral, Spinel and Chalce appear in front of Gibeon's monolith (which has pink mist with white orbs below it). The scene freezes for a brief moment to show the current Explorers Admins and their Pokémon; under Chalce's orange background of the far left, under Sidian's dark red background of the center left, under Coral's magenta background of the center right, and under Spinel's cyan background of the far right. Amethio and appear in front of them, heading for a whirlwind. Gibeon appears and uses the Laquium's power.

Shiny 50% appears in what appears to be Laqua, facing Liko, Roy, Dot, and Friede, along with , , , and Captain Pikachu. A determined Liko tosses a Poké Ball into the air, along with four others, which all release Pokémon as Terapagos turns into its Terastal Form. Cap and Crocalor ride on and respectively. Cap uses , followed by Kilowattrel using , , and fly past each other, both using . Crocalor and Charizard use , followed by Quaxwell and Floragato using and respectively. The onslaught of moves ends with Zygarde meeting Rayquaza's head-on, creating a blast of swirling wind that tears the ground apart. After this, Terapagos appears to be in its Stellar Form, using to clear the sky. Rayquaza, along with Lucius's , , and , flies off into the clear sky, each becoming a ray of dark-gray, green, red, and blue light that collides to create a bright yellow burst of energy.

All the Rising Volt Tacklers are outside the observation deck of the Brave Olivine overlooking the clear, sunny sky with optimism. The focus of this scene turns to Liko, Roy, and Dot, and then Captain Pikachu. Friede walks into a white screen. Amethio and Ceruledge have their backs turned on Spinel and Umbreon. Lucius is seen traveling with who looks to be a younger Gibeon and Rystal, a girl dressed in green carrying Terapagos. The Brave Olivine flies over a bed of clouds next to a wide cliff. 

The opening ends with the Rising Volt Tacklers performing their handshake, the focus quickly turning to just Liko. Her Rotom Phone is next to Lucius's belt and his memoirs, the picture on it depicting an event from the previous episode.

==Trivia==
This is the second consecutive Japanese opening theme song of the mainline Pokémon animated series to be sung by a non-Japanese artist, as it was sung by a Korean boy band.
This is the second consecutive Korean opening theme song of the mainline Pokémon animated series to have been translated directly from Japanese.
The instrumental of this song can be heard in HZ116.
The photo shown in HZ089 is the only one that doesn't depict an event from the previous episode, instead showing the Rising Volt Tacklers sometime between the events of Tinkatink's Ideal Hammer and From So Far Away.
Unlike the Japanese version, the Korean version uses only the first variant of the animation, and thus the photo shown on the Rotom Pad at the end does not change each episode, instead showing only the photo from HZ068.

sections.heading: Lead
sections.text:
Only One Story is the Japanese opening theme for the Rayquaza Rising arc and the fourth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ068, replacing . The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on October 11, 2024. 

A Korean version of the song, titled Only One Story (Korean ver.), is the opening theme for the Korean dub of the Rayqyaza Rising arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ068, replacing . The full version of the song was released as a digital single on April 15, 2025.

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text:
Clouds are blowing fast in the sky when the Black Rayquaza appears and flies over them. Liko, Roy, Dot, , , , and Terapagos gaze at the sunny sky. Dot moves forward first, followed by Roy, and then Liko with Terapagos. They all run forward before stopping at the cliff, with Rayquaza flying in the distance. The series logo appears just as flies into it.

Dot's Room on the Brave Olivine is draped in purple, and Dot is at her desk as an overlay of her feeling frustrated appears. The swirling clouds in the sky are draped in red, and Roy is desperately reaching out for Rayquaza as an overlay of him feeling conflicted as he holds the Sky High Pokémon's ancient Poké Ball appears. The battlefield at Naranja Academy is draped in blue, and Liko recalls one of her fainted Pokémon back into its Poké Ball as an overlay of her feeling sad about her loss appears.

Liko's overlay becomes a transition into the next scene in a colorless background. Liko takes a step, causing green leaves to appear from under her foot. She then reaches out for the full moon with the camera zooming out from her blue eyes, which appear to be the only thing colored. Liko notices a green and sparkly shadow of running past her, followed by and . They all go in front of the Rising Volt Tacklers, becoming their second-stage Evolutions and turning everything colorful. Roy and Dot appear alongside Liko, and they all run towards the Rising Volt Tacklers together.

The screen turns completely white, shortly followed by a swinging transition of Liko's pendant. Carmine is in the Kitakami Hall, when causes her to drop her Syrupy Apple. Briar reads the Scarlet Book at the Crystal Pool, and the camera zooms in on her left earring, which turns into a transition. Perrin snaps a photo with Hisuian in a bamboo forest. A darker part of the forest is shown which 's back turned.

Sidian, Coral, Spinel and Chalce appear in front of Gibeon's monolith (which has pink mist with white orbs below it). The scene freezes for a brief moment to show the current Explorers Admins and their Pokémon; under Chalce's orange background of the far left, under Sidian's dark red background of the center left, under Coral's magenta background of the center right, and under Spinel's cyan background of the far right. Amethio and appear in front of them, heading for a whirlwind. Gibeon appears and uses the Laquium's power.

Shiny 50% appears in what appears to be Laqua, facing Liko, Roy, Dot, and Friede, along with , , , and Captain Pikachu. A determined Liko tosses a Poké Ball into the air, along with four others, which all release Pokémon as Terapagos turns into its Terastal Form. Cap and Crocalor ride on and respectively. Cap uses , followed by Kilowattrel using , , and fly past each other, both using . Crocalor and Charizard use , followed by Quaxwell and Floragato using and respectively. The onslaught of moves ends with Zygarde meeting Rayquaza's head-on, creating a blast of swirling wind that tears the ground apart. After this, Terapagos appears to be in its Stellar Form, using to clear the sky. Rayquaza, along with Lucius's , , and , flies off into the clear sky, each becoming a ray of dark-gray, green, red, and blue light that collides to create a bright yellow burst of energy.

All the Rising Volt Tacklers are outside the observation deck of the Brave Olivine overlooking the clear, sunny sky with optimism. The focus of this scene turns to Liko, Roy, and Dot, and then Captain Pikachu. Friede walks into a white screen. Amethio and Ceruledge have their backs turned on Spinel and Umbreon. Lucius is seen traveling with who looks to be a younger Gibeon and Rystal, a girl dressed in green carrying Terapagos. The Brave Olivine flies over a bed of clouds next to a wide cliff. 

The opening ends with the Rising Volt Tacklers performing their handshake, the focus quickly turning to just Liko. Her Rotom Phone is next to Lucius's belt and his memoirs, the picture on it depicting an event from the previous episode.

sections.heading: Variants
sections.text:
HZ068 - HZ070: The original animation.
HZ071 - HZ073: The animation is updated to include Dot's Tinkatuff.
HZ074 - HZ081: The clips of Carmine, Briar, Perrin, and Lucius's Kleavor are replaced with Geeta and the Legendary beasts. Kleavor is added to the scene with the Six Heroes flying to the sky.
HZ082: is added to the scene with the Six Heroes.
HZ083 - HZ089: A silhouette of Laqua is seen behind the Black Rayquaza as it flies around the series title. Geeta and the Legendary beasts are replaced by flashback shots of Rystal, Lucius, Pagogo, and the Black Rayquaza, followed by a scene of Pagogo falling into a hole as a desperate Liko, who is wearing her pendant, reaches out to Rystal and Lucius.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
This is the second consecutive Japanese opening theme song of the mainline Pokémon animated series to be sung by a non-Japanese artist, as it was sung by a Korean boy band.
This is the second consecutive Korean opening theme song of the mainline Pokémon animated series to have been translated directly from Japanese.
The instrumental of this song can be heard in HZ116.
The photo shown in HZ089 is the only one that doesn't depict an event from the previous episode, instead showing the Rising Volt Tacklers sometime between the events of Tinkatink's Ideal Hammer and From So Far Away.
Unlike the Japanese version, the Korean version uses only the first variant of the animation, and thus the photo shown on the Rotom Pad at the end does not change each episode, instead showing only the photo from HZ068.

aiReadySummary.title: Only One Story
aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Only One Story
Category:Korean opening themes
Only One Story is the Japanese opening theme for the Rayquaza Rising arc and the fourth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ068, replacing . The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on October 11, 2024. 

A Korean version of the song, titled Only One Story (Korean ver.), is the opening theme for the Korean dub of the Rayqyaza Rising arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ068, replacing . The full version of the song was released as a digital single on April 15, 2025.
